notes.title: Achievements Patch
notes.notes:
Achievements should work as intended this time, fingers crossed!!  A bug responsible for failing to unlock achievements has finally been found and squashed.  So you should be able to unlock achievements again!

Thank you so much to the players who brought up this problem with achievements not unlocking!   It helps a lot to hear from you all when things are broken.  So thank you for helping Every Letter become just a little bit better with this patch!

notes.title: Vietnamese Update
notes.notes:
Added a Vietnamese localization to the game thanks to the hard work of Nhung Tran!  Find more of Nhung's work at nhungtran.carrd.co!

Also added a small fix to reduce the chance of the game incorrectly withholding achievements.  (But if you do have issues with this still, feel free to let me know in the discord; we have a bug report channel among other things!)

notes.title: The Custom Mode update is here!
notes.notes:
The big update is finally here!  Every Letter now has a Custom Mode where you can write your own requests, plus 2 new localizations: Simplified Chinese and Brazilian Portuguese.

In the new Custom Mode, you'll be able to switch between seeing the usual letter request cards in the game or making your own.  Fill out request cards with senders, recipients, and requests for the beginning, middle, and end of the game.  (And don't forget to save!)  Then start the game in either its normal mode or endless mode, and see your requests in game!

Plus, your custom request packs are saved as .txt files, meaning you can send them to your friends or try other players' requests.  There's a new channel in the Discord server specifically for sharing your custom request packs!

In addition, this update is coming with 2 new localizations: Simplified Chinese thanks to the wonderful Haigang Zhou (Mitchell_Zhou on socials), and Brazilian Portuguese thanks to the incredible Rafaela Fernandes (yumiihayato on Instagram)!  Massive thanks to them for allowing this game to reach so many new people!!

And of course, this new Custom Mode means new menus full of text, so this addition wouldn't be possible without the help of Every Letter's past translators: Lucie Teulières (@smugowlet on Twitter), Anabel Morales (@NanabelMorales on Twitter), and HasanH (@HasanH_tr on Twitter)!

Thank you all so much for making this possible.  Every Letter would not be what it is without your support.  Every review, every YouTube playthrough, everyone saying nice things about the game or having fun streaming it, it all means the world to me, so thank you!  I hope you all enjoy the update!
